name: opencode-fold
why: opencode is the Fold's execution substrate (the CLI/coding mouth). It is a white-label fork of opencode, vendored BY REFERENCE rather than byte-copied: the tree is ~560MB and already carries its own upstream-tracking discipline, so pinning the repo+commit here is the honest record. The bytes are not duplicated into the fold.

upstream.note: opencode-fold tracks this; update via its own UPSTREAM.md (git fetch upstream dev; git merge upstream/dev), never by editing vendor bytes here.

brandContract: scores-patch-points/opencode-fold UPSTREAM.md + brand/manifest.json — the entire white-label patch and its falsifying control.
roleInTheFold: Machine organ behind heimdall. Coding is dispatched through the heimdall bridge (POST /api/code -> opencode-lane.js -> a local `opencode serve`), and opencode's OWN model calls point back at the bridge's /v1, so every inference choice stays heimdall's (best/safest/cheapest).
update: cd ../opencode-fold && git fetch upstream dev && git merge upstream/dev
re-apply the brand files on conflict, bump brand/manifest.json pinnedCommit + version
bump pinnedCommit here to the new opencode-fold HEAD
falsifyingControl: if the fold byte-vendors opencode's tree (a vendor/ copy growing to MB) instead of referencing it, this contract is broken
